name: phem/phem
description: Runtime for .phpm components: a Symfony bundle with Twig rendering, class components as services, pages as Symfony routes, and Turbo/Stimulus state.

suggest.doctrine/doctrine-bundle: To run the event handlers in a Doctrine ORM transaction, and to give #[Path] props the entities of their route values
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: To test the components and the pages with Phem\Test\InteractsWithPhem
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: To load the phem Stimulus controller and its CSS with an importmap (the phemjs assets)
suggest.symfony/rate-limiter: To limit the events of a page with the #[RateLimit] attribute of Symfony 8.1
suggest.symfony/stimulus-bundle: To register the phem Stimulus controller from assets/controllers.json
